name: Build and dependencies self-audit
description: Audits the build of the Maven project in the workspace against the rule file rules/build.rules, with deterministic steps only: what the POMs and Dockerfiles pin, the dependencies as Maven resolves them, newer versions in the registries, and known vulnerabilities in the resolved dependencies. A broken rule turns the gate RED; an update, a conflict or anything not measured turns it YELLOW.

config.command: set -euo pipefail; facts offline --rules {{ package_dir }}/rules/build.rules --root . --out {{ scratch_dir }}/build-offline.json

set -euo pipefail; facts maven --rules {{ package_dir }}/rules/build.rules --root . --out {{ scratch_dir }}/build-maven.json --sbom-runtime {{ scratch_dir }}/build-sbom-runtime.cdx.json --sbom-test {{ scratch_dir }}/build-sbom-test.cdx.json --timeout 900
set -euo pipefail; facts registries --rules {{ package_dir }}/rules/build.rules --offline {{ scratch_dir }}/build-offline.json --out {{ scratch_dir }}/build-registries.json

set -euo pipefail; printf '%s' {{ block.vulns_runtime.output }} > /tmp/vulns-runtime.txt; printf '%s' {{ block.vulns_test.output }} > /tmp/vulns-test.txt; facts report --rules {{ package_dir }}/rules/build.rules --offline {{ scratch_dir }}/build-offline.json --maven {{ scratch_dir }}/build-maven.json --registries {{ scratch_dir }}/build-registries.json --vulns-runtime /tmp/vulns-runtime.txt --vulns-test /tmp/vulns-test.txt --out {{ scratch_dir }}/build-report.md
